question: 2003 से, किन टीमों ने लगातार विश्व कप फाइनल हारे? टीम का नाम और उन मैचों के वर्ष बताएं।
query: WITH finals AS (SELECT match_id, match_date, CASE WHEN match_winner = team1 THEN team2 WHEN match_winner = team2 THEN team1 ELSE 'New Zealand' END AS losing_team, CAST(strftime('%Y', match_date) AS INTEGER) AS year FROM Matches WHERE stage = 'Final') SELECT f1.losing_team AS team_name, f1.year AS year1, f2.year AS year2 FROM finals f1 JOIN finals f2 ON f1.losing_team = f2.losing_team AND f2.year = f1.year + 4 ORDER BY team_name;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    m.team1 AS team_name,
    m.season AS year
FROM 
    Matches m
WHERE 
    m.stage = 'Final'
    AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
    AND m.season >= '2003'
    AND m.team1 != m.match_winner

UNION

SELECT 
    m.team2 AS team_name,
    m.season AS year
FROM 
    Matches m
WHERE 
    m.stage = 'Final'
    AND m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
    AND m.season >= '2003'
    AND m.team2 != m.match_winner

ORDER BY 
    team_name, year;

question: 2002 के बाद के ODI विश्व कप में सबसे बड़े सफल रन चेज़ कौन से रहे? सीज़न, विजेता टीम, स्कोर, विपक्षी टीम और स्थान बताइए।
query: WITH innings_totals AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, SUM(D.runs_scored) + SUM(D.extra_runs) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team ) SELECT M.season, M.match_winner AS winning_team, I.total_runs AS chase_score, CASE WHEN M.match_winner = M.team1 THEN M.team2 ELSE M.team1 END AS opponent, M.city FROM Matches M JOIN innings_totals I ON M.match_id = I.match_id AND I.batting_team = M.match_winner WHERE M.result_type = 'wickets' AND CAST(substr(M.season, 1, 4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 ORDER BY chase_score DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    m.season,
    m.match_winner,
    d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs AS score,
    CASE 
        WHEN m.match_winner = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
        ELSE m.team1 
    END AS opponent_team,
    m.venue
FROM Matches m
JOIN Deliveries d ON m.match_id = d.match_id
WHERE m.season > '2002' 
    AND m.match_winner = d.batting_team
    AND m.stage != 'Group'
GROUP BY m.match_id
ORDER BY score DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: From the 2002/03 ODI World Cup season onwards, who scored the most centuries in a single ODI World Cup edition? Mention the player name, season and number of centuries.
query: WITH innings AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season ) SELECT P.player_name, I.season, COUNT(*) AS centuries FROM innings I JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE I.runs >= 100 GROUP BY P.player_name, I.season ORDER BY centuries DESC LIMIT 10;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, m.season, COUNT(*) AS centuries
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.season >= '2002/03'
  AND d.inning IN (1, 2)
GROUP BY p.player_name, m.season, d.match_id, d.striker_id
HAVING SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 100
GROUP BY p.player_name, m.season
ORDER BY centuries DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: Which teams recorded the highest powerplay scores in ODI World Cup history after the 2002/03 season? Mention the team, season, opponent and powerplay runs.
query: SELECT D.batting_team AS team, M.season, CASE WHEN D.batting_team = M.team1 THEN M.team2 ELSE M.team1 END AS opponent, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS powerplay_runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.over_number < 10 AND CAST(substr(M.season,1,4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team ORDER BY powerplay_runs DESC LIMIT 10;

    d.batting_team AS team,
    m.season,
    CASE 
        WHEN d.batting_team = m.team1 THEN m.team2 
        ELSE m.team1

question: Which players have the most 50+ scores in a World Cup while batting at No 5 or below? Mention the number of scores, the player and the season.
query: WITH batter_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id, MIN(D.delivery_id) AS first_ball, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id), positions AS (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY first_ball) AS batting_pos FROM batter_innings) SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS fifties FROM positions POS JOIN Matches M ON POS.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON POS.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE POS.runs >= 50 AND POS.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY fifties DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
WITH PlayerPositionInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        d.striker_id AS player_id,
        m.season,
        SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_in_inning
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
),
FilteredInnings AS (
    SELECT 
        ppi.player_id,
        ppi.season,
        ppi.runs_in_inning
    FROM PlayerPositionInnings ppi
    JOIN PlayerInMatch pim ON ppi.match_id = pim.match_id AND ppi.player_id = pim.player_id
    WHERE ppi.runs_in_inning >= 50
),
Player50PlusCounts AS (
    SELECT 
        player_id,
        season,
        COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_count
    FROM FilteredInnings
    GROUP BY player_id, season
),
Max50Plus AS (
    SELECT MAX(fifty_plus_count) AS max_count
    FROM Player50PlusCounts
)
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    p50.season,
    p50.fifty_plus_count
FROM Player50PlusCounts p50
JOIN Players p ON p50.player_id = p.player_id
JOIN Max50Plus m ON p50.fifty_plus_count = m.max_count
ORDER BY p50.fifty_plus_count DESC, p.player_name;

query: WITH batter_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id, MIN(D.delivery_id) AS first_ball, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id), positions AS (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY first_ball) AS batting_pos FROM batter_innings) SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS fifties FROM positions POS JOIN Matches M ON POS.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON POS.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE POS.runs >= 50 AND POS.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY fifties DESC LIMIT 3;

question: Which team took the highest average number of balls to reach a fifty in the 2019 ODI World Cup? Mention the team and the average balls taken.

SELECT 
    d.batting_team AS team,

query: WITH batter_innings AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id, MIN(D.delivery_id) AS first_ball, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.match_id, D.batting_team, D.striker_id), positions AS (SELECT match_id, batting_team, striker_id, runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY match_id, batting_team ORDER BY first_ball) AS batting_pos FROM batter_innings) SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS fifties FROM positions POS JOIN Matches M ON POS.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON POS.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE POS.runs >= 50 AND POS.batting_pos >= 5 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY fifties DESC LIMIT 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    m.season,
    COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores
FROM 
    Deliveries d
    INNER JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    INNER JOIN Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
    INNER JOIN PlayerInMatch pm ON m.match_id = pm.match_id AND d.striker_id = pm.player_id
WHERE 
    d.inning = 1 
    AND pm.team_name = d.batting_team
    AND d.batting_team = pm.team_name
    AND d.striker_id = pm.player_id
GROUP BY 
    p.player_name, m.season
HAVING 
    SUM(d.runs_scored) >= 50
ORDER BY 
    fifty_plus_scores DESC
LIMIT 1;

query: WITH nz_matches AS ( SELECT match_id, match_date, stage FROM Matches WHERE season = '2019' AND stage != 'Final' AND (team1 = 'New Zealand' OR team2 = 'New Zealand') ORDER BY match_date DESC LIMIT 3 ), pp1_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN nz_matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE D.batting_team = 'New Zealand' AND D.over_number < 10 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT CASE WHEN M.stage = 'League' THEN 'Group' ELSE M.stage END AS stage, P.runs || '/' || P.wickets AS powerplay_score FROM pp1_scores P JOIN nz_matches M ON P.match_id = M.match_id ORDER BY M.match_date;

question: After JC Archer, MA Wood and CR Woakes, which England bowler recorded the fourth highest wicket tally in a single World Cup edition from 2003 onwards? Mention the player name, season and number of wickets.
query: WITH england_wickets AS (SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') AND D.bowling_team = 'England' GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season) SELECT player_name, season, wickets FROM england_wickets ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, m.season, COUNT(*) AS wickets
FROM Deliveries d
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
WHERE m.season >= '2003' AND m.stage != 'Group' AND d.bowler_id IN (
    SELECT d.bowler_id
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    JOIN Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
    WHERE m.season >= '2003' AND m.stage != 'Group' AND p.player_name NOT IN ('JC Archer', 'MA Wood', 'CR Woakes')
    GROUP BY d.bowler_id, m.season
    ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 3
)
GROUP BY d.bowler_id, m.season
ORDER BY wickets DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: ਵਿਰਾਟ ਕੋਹਲੀ ਦੇ ਰਿਕਾਰਡ 2023/24 ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ, 2002/03 ਤੋਂ ਬਾਅਦ ਇੱਕ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ ਦੂਜੇ ਅਤੇ ਤੀਜੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਰਨ ਕਿਹੜੇ ਖਿਡਾਰੀਆਂ ਨੇ ਬਣਾਏ? ਖਿਡਾਰੀ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ, ਸੀਜ਼ਨ ਅਤੇ ਕੁੱਲ ਰਨ ਦੱਸੋ।
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS total_runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE CAST(substr(M.season,1,4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY total_runs DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name, m.season, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE m.season IN ('2003', '2007', '2011', '2015', '2019', '2023')
GROUP BY p.player_id, m.season
HAVING m.season = (
    SELECT season
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season IN ('2003', '2007', '2011', '2015', '2019', '2023')
    ORDER BY total_runs DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 1
)
OR m.season = (
    SELECT season
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season IN ('2003', '2007', '2011', '2015', '2019', '2023')
    ORDER BY total_runs DESC
    LIMIT 1 OFFSET 2
)
ORDER BY total_runs DESC
LIMIT 2;

question: 2019 ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਵਿੱਚ ਕਿਸ ਟੀਮ ਨੇ ਔਸਤ ਤੌਰ 'ਤੇ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਵਿੱਚ ਆਪਣਾ ਪਚਾਸਾ ਪੂਰਾ ਕੀਤਾ? ਟੀਮ ਦਾ ਨਾਮ ਅਤੇ ਔਸਤ ਗੇਂਦਾਂ ਦੀ ਗਿਣਤੀ ਦੱਸੋ।
query: WITH cumulative AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, D.batting_team, D.over_number, D.ball_number, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.season = '2019'), milestone AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, batting_team, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_50 FROM cumulative WHERE running_runs >= 50 GROUP BY match_id, striker_id) SELECT batting_team, ROUND(AVG(balls_to_50), 0) AS avg_balls_to_50 FROM milestone GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY avg_balls_to_50 DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT 
    d.batting_team AS team_name,
    AVG(d.over_number * 6 + d.ball_number) AS avg_balls_to_fifty
FROM

WHERE 
    m.season = '2019' 
    AND d.batting_team = d.batting_team

query: WITH cumulative AS (SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, D.batting_team, D.over_number, D.ball_number, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS running_runs, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY D.match_id, D.striker_id ORDER BY D.over_number, D.ball_number) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id WHERE M.season = '2019'), milestone AS (SELECT match_id, striker_id, batting_team, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_50 FROM cumulative WHERE running_runs >= 50 GROUP BY match_id, striker_id) SELECT batting_team, ROUND(AVG(balls_to_50), 0) AS avg_balls_to_50 FROM milestone GROUP BY batting_team ORDER BY avg_balls_to_50 DESC LIMIT 1;

question: What were Jason Roy's scores in the last four matches of the 2019 ODI World Cup? Mention the match stage, opponent and runs scored.

question: Who took the most catches (including wicketkeeper dismissals) in a single ODI World Cup edition? Mention the player name, season and number of catches.

question: Which batsmen recorded the most 50-plus scores in a single ODI World Cup edition after 2002/03? Mention the player name, season and number of 50-plus scores.
query: WITH innings_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.match_id, D.striker_id, M.season ), fifty_plus AS ( SELECT striker_id, season, COUNT(*) AS fifty_plus_scores FROM innings_scores WHERE runs >= 50 GROUP BY striker_id, season ) SELECT P.player_name, F.season, F.fifty_plus_scores FROM fifty_plus F JOIN Players P ON F.striker_id = P.player_id ORDER BY fifty_plus_scores DESC LIMIT 4;

question: What is the largest lower-order recovery in a successful run chase in ODI World Cup history (runs added after the fall of the fifth wicket)?
query: WITH chase_wins AS ( SELECT match_id, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'wickets' ), wicket_sequence AS ( SELECT D.match_id, (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number AS ball_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number ) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') ), fifth_wicket_ball AS ( SELECT match_id, ball_seq AS ball_at_5w FROM wicket_sequence WHERE wicket_num = 5 ), score_at_5w AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_at_5w FROM Deliveries D JOIN fifth_wicket_ball F ON D.match_id = F.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number <= F.ball_at_5w GROUP BY D.match_id ), final_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS final_score FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT M.season, C.match_winner, (F.final_score - W.runs_at_5w) AS recovery_runs FROM score_at_5w W JOIN final_scores F ON W.match_id = F.match_id JOIN chase_wins C ON C.match_id = W.match_id JOIN Matches M ON M.match_id = W.match_id ORDER BY recovery_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT MAX(runs_scored) AS max_lower_order_recovery
FROM (
    SELECT d.match_id, SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_scored
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.match_winner = d.batting_team
      AND d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
      AND d.wicket_type != ''
      AND (
        SELECT COUNT(*)
        FROM Deliveries d2
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id
          AND d2.inning = d.inning
          AND d2.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
          AND d2.wicket_type != ''
          AND d2.delivery_id <= d.delivery_id
      ) >= 5
    GROUP BY d.match_id, d.inning
) AS recovery;

question: ODI विश्व कप इतिहास में सफल रन चेज़ में सबसे बड़ी लोअर-ऑर्डर रिकवरी क्या है (पाँचवीं विकेट के बाद जोड़े गए रन)?
query: WITH chase_wins AS ( SELECT match_id, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'wickets' ), wicket_sequence AS ( SELECT D.match_id, (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number AS ball_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number ) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') ), fifth_wicket_ball AS ( SELECT match_id, ball_seq AS ball_at_5w FROM wicket_sequence WHERE wicket_num = 5 ), score_at_5w AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_at_5w FROM Deliveries D JOIN fifth_wicket_ball F ON D.match_id = F.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number <= F.ball_at_5w GROUP BY D.match_id ), final_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS final_score FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT M.season, C.match_winner, (F.final_score - W.runs_at_5w) AS recovery_runs FROM score_at_5w W JOIN final_scores F ON W.match_id = F.match_id JOIN chase_wins C ON C.match_id = W.match_id JOIN Matches M ON M.match_id = W.match_id ORDER BY recovery_runs DESC LIMIT 1;

SELECT MAX(fifth_wicket_plus_partnership) AS max_lower_order_recovery
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,

        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS fifth_wicket_plus_partnership
    FROM Deliveries d

    )
    AND d.inning = (

        FROM PlayerInMatch 
        WHERE match_id = d.match_id AND team_name = (
            SELECT match_winner FROM Matches m WHERE m.match_id = d.match_id
        )

    )
    AND d.delivery_id > (
        SELECT COALESCE(MAX(d2.delivery_id), 0)
        FROM Deliveries d2
        WHERE d2.match_id = d.match_id
        AND d2.inning = d.inning
        AND d2.wicket_type IS NOT NULL

) AS recovery;

query: WITH chase_wins AS ( SELECT match_id, match_winner FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'wickets' ), wicket_sequence AS ( SELECT D.match_id, (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number AS ball_seq, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY D.match_id ORDER BY (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number ) AS wicket_num FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt', 'obstructing the field') ), fifth_wicket_ball AS ( SELECT match_id, ball_seq AS ball_at_5w FROM wicket_sequence WHERE wicket_num = 5 ), score_at_5w AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS runs_at_5w FROM Deliveries D JOIN fifth_wicket_ball F ON D.match_id = F.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 AND (D.over_number * 6) + D.ball_number <= F.ball_at_5w GROUP BY D.match_id ), final_scores AS ( SELECT D.match_id, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.extra_runs) AS final_score FROM Deliveries D JOIN chase_wins C ON D.match_id = C.match_id WHERE D.inning = 2 GROUP BY D.match_id ) SELECT M.season, C.match_winner, (F.final_score - W.runs_at_5w) AS recovery_runs FROM score_at_5w W JOIN final_scores F ON W.match_id = F.match_id JOIN chase_wins C ON C.match_id = W.match_id JOIN Matches M ON M.match_id = W.match_id ORDER BY recovery_runs DESC LIMIT 1;
generated_sql:
SELECT MAX(w5_runs) AS max_fifth_wicket_recovery
FROM (
    SELECT 
        d.match_id,
        SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS w5_runs
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN (
        SELECT 
            match_id,
            MAX(over_number * 6 + ball_number) AS fifth_wicket_over_ball
        FROM Deliveries
        WHERE wicket_type IS NOT NULL 
          AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM Deliveries d2 
               WHERE d2.match_id = Deliveries.match_id 
                 AND d2.inning = Deliveries.inning 
                 AND d2.over_number * 6 + d2.ball_number <= Deliveries.over_number * 6 + Deliveries.ball_number 
                 AND d2.wicket_type IS NOT NULL) = 5
        GROUP BY match_id, inning
    ) w5 ON d.match_id = w5.match_id 
       AND d.inning = (
           SELECT batting_innings 
           FROM Matches m 
           WHERE m.match_id = d.match_id 
             AND m.match_winner = d.batting_team
       )
       AND (d.over_number * 6 + d.ball_number) > w5.fifth_wicket_over_ball
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
    WHERE m.match_winner = d.batting_team
    GROUP BY d.match_id
);

question: ODI विश्व कप इतिहास में पीछा करते हुए सबसे अधिक मैच किस टीम ने जीते हैं?
query: SELECT match_winner, COUNT(*) AS chase_wins FROM Matches WHERE result_type = 'wickets' GROUP BY match_winner ORDER BY chase_wins DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    m.match_winner AS team,
    COUNT(*) AS chase_wins
FROM 
    Matches m
WHERE 
    m.match_winner IS NOT NULL
    AND m.match_winner IN (m.team1, m.team2)
    AND m.match_winner != (
        SELECT 
            CASE 
                WHEN t1.batting_score IS NOT NULL THEN m.team2 
                ELSE m.team1 
            END
        FROM (
            SELECT 
                d.batting_team,
                SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS batting_score
            FROM 
                Deliveries d
            WHERE 
                d.match_id = m.match_id 
                AND d.inning = 1
            GROUP BY 
                d.batting_team
        ) t1
        CROSS JOIN (
            SELECT 
                d.batting_team,
                SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS batting_score
            FROM 
                Deliveries d
            WHERE 
                d.match_id = m.match_id 
                AND d.inning = 2
            GROUP BY 
                d.batting_team
        ) t2
        WHERE 
            t1.batting_score > t2.batting_score
    )
GROUP BY 
    m.match_winner
ORDER BY 
    chase_wins DESC
LIMIT 1;

question: 2002/03 के बाद एक ODI विश्व कप संस्करण में दक्षिण अफ्रीका के किन गेंदबाज़ों ने दूसरे और तीसरे सबसे अधिक विकेट लिए? खिलाड़ी का नाम, सीज़न और विकेटों की संख्या बताइए।
query: SELECT P.player_name, M.season, COUNT(*) AS wickets FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.bowler_id = P.player_id WHERE CAST(SUBSTR(M.season,1,4) AS INTEGER) >= 2002 AND D.bowling_team = 'South Africa' AND D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY P.player_name, M.season ORDER BY wickets DESC LIMIT 2 OFFSET 1;

    p.player_name,
    m.season,
    COUNT(d.delivery_id) AS wickets
FROM

JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id

GROUP BY

question: Before the 2023 ODI Cricket World Cup, which teams had won the most World Cup semi-final and final matches combined? Return the top 3 teams along with number of matches won.
query: SELECT match_winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS knockout_wins FROM Matches WHERE stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') AND season < 2023 AND match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_winner ORDER BY knockout_wins DESC, team LIMIT 3;

    COUNT(*) AS matches_won
FROM (
    SELECT 
        team1 AS team_name
    FROM Matches
    WHERE season != '2023'

    UNION ALL

question: List players having most five-fors in World Cups.
query: SELECT P.player_name, COUNT(*) AS five_fors FROM (SELECT match_id, bowler_id, COUNT(player_out_id) AS wkts FROM Deliveries WHERE wicket_type NOT IN ('run out', 'retired hurt') GROUP BY match_id, bowler_id HAVING wkts >= 5) AS Innings JOIN Players AS P ON Innings.bowler_id = P.player_id GROUP BY P.player_name ORDER BY five_fors DESC LIMIT 2;

    p.player_name,
    COUNT(*) AS five_wicket_hauls

    Players p

    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id

    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

    d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL

question: 2023 ODI क्रिकेट विश्व कप से पहले, विश्व कप के सेमीफाइनल और फाइनल मैचों को मिलाकर सबसे अधिक जीत किस टीम ने हासिल की थी? शीर्ष 3 टीमें बताइए, जीते गए मैचों की संख्या के साथ।
query: SELECT match_winner AS team, COUNT(*) AS knockout_wins FROM Matches WHERE stage IN ('Semi Final', 'Final') AND season < 2023 AND match_winner IS NOT NULL GROUP BY match_winner ORDER BY knockout_wins DESC, team LIMIT 3;

question: What are the best economies for bowlers in the 2019 ODI World Cup (minimum 50 overs bowled)? Show top 5 along with number of matches and wickets.

question: 2019 ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਐਡੀਸ਼ਨ ਵਿੱਚ CH Gayle ਦੇ ਬੱਲੇਬਾਜ਼ੀ ਅੰਕੜੇ ਕੀ ਸਨ? ਮੈਚ, ਪਾਰੀਆਂ, ਦੌੜਾਂ, ਔਸਤ ਅਤੇ ਸਟ੍ਰਾਈਕ ਰੇਟ ਸ਼ਾਮਲ ਕਰੋ।
query: WITH innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, M.season, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS balls, MAX(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id = D.striker_id AND D.wicket_type != 'retired hurt' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS dismissed FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id JOIN Players P ON D.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE P.player_name = 'CH Gayle' AND M.season = 2019 GROUP BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT season, COUNT(DISTINCT match_id) AS matches, COUNT(*) AS innings, SUM(runs) AS total_runs, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(dismissed), 0), 2) AS avg, ROUND(SUM(runs) * 100.0 / NULLIF(SUM(balls), 0), 2) AS sr FROM innings GROUP BY season ORDER BY season;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.inning) AS innings,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(CASE WHEN d.wicket_type IS NOT NULL AND d.striker_id = p.player_id THEN 1 END) AS average,
    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(d.delivery_id) * 100 AS strike_rate
FROM Players p
JOIN Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.striker_id
JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE p.player_name = 'CH Gayle' AND m.season = '2019'
GROUP BY p.player_id;

question: 2015 के ODI विश्व कप में AB de Villiers' के बल्लेबाजी आँकड़े क्या थे? इसमें खेले गए मैचों की संख्या, पारियाँ, कुल रन, शतक, बल्लेबाजी औसत और स्ट्राइक रेट बताइए।

question: ODI विश्व कप मैचों में भारत और ऑस्ट्रेलिया के बीच हेड-टू-हेड रिकॉर्ड क्या है?

    CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS FLOAT) / (SUM(d.over_number * 6 + d.ball_number) / 6.0) AS economy_rate
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    m.season = '2019'

    p.player_name,
    COUNT(DISTINCT d.match_id) AS matches,
    COUNT(d.delivery_id) / 6.0 AS overs,
    SUM(d.wides + d.noballs) AS extras,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS runs_conceded,
    COUNT(d.wicket_type) AS wickets,
    ROUND(CAST(SUM(d.runs_scored) AS FLOAT) / (COUNT(d.delivery_id) / 6.0), 2) AS economy
FROM 
    Players p
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON p.player_id = d.bowler_id

question: ODI ప్రపంచకప్ చరిత్రలో అత్యంత వేగవంతమైన సెంచరీలు (అతి తక్కువ బంతుల్లో) సాధించినవారు ఎవరు? టాప్ 5 ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లను చూపించండి.
query: WITH ball_progress AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, M.season, D.delivery_id, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning ORDER BY D.delivery_id) AS cumulative_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning ORDER BY D.delivery_id) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id=M.match_id), milestones AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, season, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_hundred FROM ball_progress WHERE cumulative_runs>=100 GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning, season), innings AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, M.season, I.runs, MS.balls_to_hundred FROM milestones MS JOIN innings I ON MS.striker_id=I.striker_id AND MS.match_id=I.match_id AND MS.inning=I.inning JOIN Players P ON MS.striker_id=P.player_id JOIN Matches M ON MS.match_id=M.match_id ORDER BY balls_to_hundred ASC, runs DESC LIMIT 5;

query: WITH ball_progress AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, M.season, D.delivery_id, SUM(D.runs_scored) OVER (PARTITION BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning ORDER BY D.delivery_id) AS cumulative_runs, SUM(CASE WHEN D.wides = 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning ORDER BY D.delivery_id) AS balls_faced FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id=M.match_id), milestones AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, season, MIN(balls_faced) AS balls_to_hundred FROM ball_progress WHERE cumulative_runs>=100 GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning, season), innings AS (SELECT striker_id, match_id, inning, SUM(runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries GROUP BY striker_id, match_id, inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, M.season, I.runs, MS.balls_to_hundred FROM milestones MS JOIN innings I ON MS.striker_id=I.striker_id AND MS.match_id=I.match_id AND MS.inning=I.inning JOIN Players P ON MS.striker_id=P.player_id JOIN Matches M ON MS.match_id=M.match_id ORDER BY balls_to_hundred ASC, runs DESC LIMIT 5;

SELECT

    dim.team_name,

SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    COUNT(fd.fielder_id) AS catch_count
FROM 
    FielderDismissals fd
JOIN 
    Deliveries d ON fd.delivery_id = d.delivery_id
JOIN 
    Players p ON fd.fielder_id = p.player_id
WHERE 
    d.wicket_type = 'caught'
GROUP BY 
    fd.fielder_id, p.player_name
ORDER BY 
    catch_count DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵੱਧ ਵਿਅਕਤੀਗਤ ਪਾਰੀ ਸਕੋਰ ਕੀ ਹਨ? ਟਾਪ 5 ਦਿਖਾਓ।
query: WITH innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, M.season, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id=M.match_id GROUP BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, I.season, I.runs FROM innings I JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id=P.player_id ORDER BY I.runs DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    SUM(d.runs_scored) AS individual_score
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.striker_id = p.player_id
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
WHERE 
    m.stage = 'Group' OR m.stage IN ('Final', 'Semi Final', 'Quarter Final', 'Super Six', 'Super Eight')
GROUP BY 
    d.match_id, d.inning, d.striker_id
ORDER BY 
    individual_score DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: ODI ప్రపంచకప్ చరిత్రలో ఒకే ఇన్నింగ్స్‌లో అత్యుత్తమ బౌలింగ్ గణాంకాలు ఏవి? ఆటగాడు, సీజన్, వికెట్లు మరియు ఇచ్చిన పరుగులతో సహా టాప్ 5 చూపించండి.
query: WITH bowling AS (SELECT D.bowler_id, D.match_id, M.season, SUM(CASE WHEN D.player_out_id IS NOT NULL AND D.wicket_type NOT IN ('run out','retired hurt','obstructing the field') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wkts, SUM(D.runs_scored + D.wides + D.noballs) AS runs_conceded FROM Deliveries D JOIN Matches M ON D.match_id = M.match_id GROUP BY D.bowler_id, D.match_id) SELECT P.player_name AS player, B.season, B.wkts, B.runs_conceded FROM bowling B JOIN Players P ON B.bowler_id = P.player_id ORDER BY B.wkts DESC, B.runs_conceded ASC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    p.player_name,
    m.season,
    d.bowler_id,
    COUNT(wd.delivery_id) AS wickets,
    SUM(d.runs_scored + d.extra_runs) AS runs_conceded
FROM 
    Deliveries d
JOIN 
    Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id
JOIN 
    Players p ON d.bowler_id = p.player_id
LEFT JOIN 
    Deliveries wd ON d.match_id = wd.match_id 
    AND d.inning = wd.inning 
    AND d.over_number = wd.over_number 
    AND d.ball_number = wd.ball_number 
    AND wd.wicket_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 
    d.match_id, d.inning, d.bowler_id
ORDER BY 
    wickets DESC, runs_conceded ASC
LIMIT 5;

question: ਘੱਟੋ-ਘੱਟ 20 ਮੈਚ ਖੇਡਣ ਵਾਲੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਵਿੱਚੋਂ ODI ਵਿਸ਼ਵ ਕੱਪ ਦੇ ਇਤਿਹਾਸ ਵਿੱਚ ਸਭ ਤੋਂ ਵਧੀਆ ਜਿੱਤ ਪ੍ਰਤੀਸ਼ਤ ਕਿਹੜੀਆਂ ਟੀਮਾਂ ਦਾ ਹੈ? ਟਾਪ 5 ਦਿਖਾਓ।
query: WITH team_matches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS win_pct FROM team_matches GROUP BY team HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY win_pct DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT 
    team_name,
    CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team_name THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS FLOAT) * 100 / COUNT(*) AS win_percentage
FROM (
    SELECT team1 AS team_name, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team_name, match_id, match_winner FROM Matches
) AS team_matches
GROUP BY team_name
HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 5;

question: Who are the top 5 batters by most centuries scored across all ODI World Cup editions?
query: WITH innings AS (SELECT D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning, SUM(D.runs_scored) AS runs FROM Deliveries D GROUP BY D.striker_id, D.match_id, D.inning) SELECT P.player_name AS player, COUNT(*) AS hundreds FROM innings I JOIN Players P ON I.striker_id = P.player_id WHERE I.runs >= 100 GROUP BY I.striker_id,P.player_name ORDER BY hundreds DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
SELECT p.player_name
FROM Players p
JOIN (
    SELECT d.striker_id, 
           SUM(d.runs_scored) AS total_runs_in_innings
    FROM Deliveries d
    JOIN Matches m ON d.match_id = m.match_id

question: Which teams have the best win percentage in ODI World Cup history among teams that have played at least 20 matches? Show the top 5.
query: WITH team_matches AS (SELECT team1 AS team, match_winner FROM Matches UNION ALL SELECT team2 AS team, match_winner FROM Matches) SELECT team, COUNT(*) AS matches, SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS wins, ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN match_winner = team THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS win_pct FROM team_matches GROUP BY team HAVING COUNT(*) >= 20 ORDER BY win_pct DESC LIMIT 5;
generated_sql:
WITH TeamMatches AS (
    SELECT team1 AS team, match_id, match_winner
    FROM Matches
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
    UNION ALL
    SELECT team2 AS team, match_id, match_winner
    FROM Matches
    WHERE match_winner IS NOT NULL
),
TeamStats AS (
    SELECT
        team,
        COUNT(*) AS matches_played,
        SUM(CASE WHEN team = match_winner THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS matches_won
    FROM TeamMatches
    GROUP BY team
    HAVING matches_played >= 20
),
WinPercentage AS (
    SELECT
        team,
        matches_won * 100.0 / matches_played AS win_percentage
    FROM TeamStats
)
SELECT team
FROM WinPercentage
ORDER BY win_percentage DESC
LIMIT 5;
